_comment: INTENDED FAILURE (context_loss at intake): Intake truncates at 6000 chars, inside Section 12. Section 14 (a $95,000.00 early termination fee that overrides the 90-day termination for convenience) is cut, so later steps never see it and the summary describes termination without the fee.

key_terms: liability capped at 12 months of fees

classification.rationale: A software implementation and support agreement between a provider and a hospital with fees, term, service levels and termination clauses.

summarization.headline: Copperline Systems will implement and support its scheduling platform for Ridgeway Regional Hospital for 36 months at $12,500.00 a month.
key_points: 99.5% monthly availability, with service credits if missed.
summarization.term: 36 months from October 1, 2025, renewing for 12-month periods
key_obligations: Provider configures the platform, migrates records and trains up to 120 staff
Client pays $12,500.00 per month from October 1, 2025
Provider notifies Client of data breaches within 24 hours
summarization.termination_terms: Either party may terminate for convenience with 90 days' written notice, or immediately for a material breach not cured within 30 days.
